Auto Mode Workflow
1. Begin → Records audio to temporary file
2. Stop → Automatically transcribes using Whisper
3. Summarise → Generates AI summary and saves to database
4. Cleanup → Temporary files are automatically deleted
💾 All data is permanently stored in the database
